subject: Android app crashes when opening tasks with images
body:
Hi there,

Since the Android app updated to version 5.2.0 last Thursday, it crashes every time I open a task that has an image attachment. The app freezes for a second, then closes completely. Tasks without images open fine. I've cleared the app cache, reinstalled it, and restarted my phone, and nothing has helped.

My phone is a Samsung Galaxy S23 running Android 14. Two of my colleagues with Pixel phones say they have the same problem, so I don't think it's just my device. Everything works normally on the web version, so we can still get work done at our desks, but most of our site inspectors only have their phones with them in the field, and nearly every inspection task has photos attached.

Is there an older version we can go back to while this gets fixed? Or an ETA for a fix?

Thanks,
Gavin Mortensen
Site Operations, Northfield Construction
Workspace: northfield-build.ourapp.com
ios app wont open. just white screen

subject: Push notifications stopped
body: I stopped getting push notifications on my iPhone about a week ago. Notifications are enabled in iOS settings and in the app's settings. Email notifications still arrive. My colleague on Android still gets pushes. I've logged out and back in.

subject: iPad app layout broken in landscape
body: On the iPad app in landscape mode, the task detail panel overlaps the board and you can't close it. Portrait works fine. iPad Air, iPadOS 18. Makes the app pretty much unusable for me since I always use a keyboard case.

The mobile app logs me out every time I close it. I have to enter my password and 2FA code every single time I open it, maybe 20 times a day. It didn't do this before the last update. Android, Pixel 8.

subject: App store version outdated?
body: The App Store still shows version 4.8 as the latest, but your release notes mention 5.0 with the new offline mode. Is 5.0 only available in some countries? We're in South Africa.

subject: Mobile app can't upload photos
body: Taking a photo from inside the app and attaching it to a task fails with "Upload failed". Picking an existing photo from the gallery works. Camera permission is granted. iPhone 15, iOS 18.1.
Is there a mobile app for Windows tablets? Our warehouse team uses Surface Go tablets and the website is awkward on them.

subject: Mobile app shows old data
body: The Android app shows the board as it was yesterday morning. Pull-to-refresh spins but nothing changes. On the web everything is current. I've tried clearing the cache and logging out. It's a problem because our drivers use the app to see their route assignments, and yesterday two of them went to the wrong addresses because they were looking at stale data. We have 14 drivers on Android. Account: acct_dr1v3r

subject: Dark mode in app is unreadable
body: In the iOS app with dark mode on, the text in comments is dark grey on a black background, so you basically can't read it. Light mode is fine. Screenshots available if needed.
The Android widget doesn't update. It shows my tasks from 3 days ago. Removing and re-adding the widget shows the right tasks for about an hour, then it freezes again.

subject: App crashes + feature idea
body: The iOS app crashes when I try to share a task link via the share sheet. Also, would be amazing if the app had a home screen widget like the Android one does. Thanks!

subject: Face ID login broken
body: Face ID login in the iOS app stopped working after I updated to iOS 18.2. It says "Face ID not available" and asks for my password every time. Face ID works for my other apps.

subject: Mobile app + billing
body: Hi, the Android app keeps showing "Upgrade to Pro to use this feature" when I try to open the calendar view, but we're already on Business. On the web the calendar works. Also, could you send me last month's invoice? I can't find it.

Our field technicians use the app offline all day and sync at night. Since the latest update, the offline sync fails with "Sync error M-203" and they lose everything they entered that day. This has happened for 3 days in a row now. We've had to go back to paper forms, which is exactly what we bought this app to get away from. Please treat this as urgent, we're 30 technicians. Workspace ID ws_19884.

subject: Voice-to-text in app
body: The microphone button in the task comment box on Android does nothing. It used to let me dictate comments. Microphone permission is on.
app keeps crashing on my iphone 12 since the update, like every 2 minutes. please fix

subject: Can't log into the app with SSO
body: When I tap "Log in with SSO" in the Android app, it opens our Okta page, I log in, and then it just shows a blank screen instead of returning to the app. SSO works on web. Other colleagues on iOS don't have this problem.

subject: App uses a lot of battery
body: The iOS app is using about 30% of my battery according to the battery settings, even though I only open it a few times a day. It seems to be running in the background constantly. Is there a setting to stop background refresh just for your app?
Is there an Apple Watch app? I'd love to see my tasks for the day on my wrist.

subject: Emails not arriving
body: None of our team has received any notification emails from you since yesterday afternoon. Not in spam either. In-app notifications work. We rely on email because half of our team doesn't open the app every day. Workspace: moorland-events.ourapp.com
your emails go to spam for everyone at our company. can you fix your SPF/DKIM? our IT says it fails DMARC

subject: Email notifications look broken
body: The notification emails we get now have broken formatting: the task title is missing, there's raw HTML showing in places, and the "View task" button doesn't link anywhere. Started with emails on Monday. Tested in Outlook desktop and Gmail web, same thing.

subject: Daily digest not sent
body:
Hello,

Our whole team relies on the daily digest email to start the day. It lists what's due and what changed overnight, and many of our staff only check the app when the digest tells them something needs attention. For the last four working days, nobody on our team (about 35 people) has received the digest.

All other notification emails are arriving normally: mentions, assignments, and comment replies all come through. The digest setting is still turned on in everyone's preferences, and the send time is set to 7:00 local time. We're in the Europe/Madrid time zone.

Our IT team has checked our mail server logs and there is no record of any digest emails being received and filtered, so it looks like they're never being sent from your side.

Could you please check what's happening with digest emails for our workspace?

Many thanks,
Isabel Moreno
Operations Coordinator
Workspace ID: ws_81503
I'm getting email notifications in the wrong language (Portuguese) even though my account language is English. Everything in the app is English. Weird.

subject: Notification emails delayed
body: Notification emails are arriving 2-3 hours after the event. For example, someone assigns me a task at 9am and I get the email at noon. In-app notifications are instant. Is there a delay on your mail servers?

subject: Emails bouncing
body: Our mail server is rejecting your notification emails with "550 5.7.1 message rejected due to policy". Our IT says your sending IP was added to a blocklist. Could you check with your email provider? About 90 of our staff aren't getting anything.
The "reply by email" feature stopped working. When I reply to a notification email, the reply used to show up as a comment on the task. Now nothing happens, no bounce either.

subject: Branded emails
body: We set up a custom sender name and logo for our client-facing emails (Business plan feature). Since last week, emails go out with your default branding instead. The settings page still shows our logo.

subject: Emails to external guests
body: Our clients (added as guests) aren't receiving any email notifications, even when we @mention them. Internal members get emails fine. Several clients have complained they didn't know we were waiting on them. Workspace ID W-50122.
Receiving the same notification email 4-5 times for one comment. Started this morning. It's flooding my inbox.

subject: Emails not arriving + need to add users
body: Hi, notification emails stopped arriving for everyone on our team around the 14th. Can you look into it? Also, we have 3 new people starting next week. What's the fastest way to add them all? Thanks, Omar

subject: Scheduled report emails missing
body: We have 4 scheduled reports that email PDFs to our managers every Friday. Last Friday none of them arrived. The reports still show as "scheduled" in settings. Can you resend them and check why they failed? Our weekly leadership review depends on them.
Your emails say "Do not reply" but the reply-to address is set to our support team's inbox, so clients keep replying and we get confused. Can the reply-to be changed?

subject: Email links go to wrong workspace
body: Clicking "Open task" in notification emails takes me to my personal workspace, where the task doesn't exist, instead of our company workspace. I'm in both workspaces. Very confusing. I have to find the task manually every time.

subject: How do I create a recurring task?
body: How do I make a task repeat every two weeks? I see the repeat option but it only offers daily, weekly, monthly.
how to add a column to a board

subject: Setting up our first project
body:
Hi,

We're a small non-profit (6 staff, lots of volunteers) and we've just started using your app to plan our annual fundraising gala. None of us have used a project management tool before, so we're feeling a bit lost.

What we'd like to do is have one project for the gala, split into areas like venue, catering, sponsors, auction items, and volunteers, with tasks and deadlines in each area. Some tasks depend on others: we can't print the programme until the auction items are confirmed, for example.

Is there a template that's close to this? Should the areas be sections, sub-projects, or tags? And how do we show that one task has to wait for another? Any pointers to the right help articles would be wonderful. We've watched the intro video, but it moved a bit fast for us.

Thank you so much,
Grace Obuya
Events Coordinator, Riverside Food Bank

subject: Keyboard shortcuts
body: Is there a list of keyboard shortcuts? I'm looking specifically for how to quickly move a task to the next column without the mouse.
How do I see all tasks assigned to me across every project, in one list? I can only see them project by project right now.

subject: Task dependencies
body: How do I set up a dependency so that task B can't start until task A is done? I found the "blocked by" field but it doesn't seem to prevent anything, it just shows a label. Is that how it's meant to work?

subject: Filter by multiple tags
body: Can I filter a board to show tasks that have BOTH the "urgent" and "client" tags? When I pick two tags, it shows tasks with either one, not both.
Hello, how can I make a copy of a task with all its subtasks and put it in a different project? I do the same checklist every month for each new client.

subject: Using forms to collect requests
body: I want other departments to be able to submit design requests to our team without having access to our project. Someone mentioned "forms". How do I set one up, and where do the submissions go?

subject: Gantt view
body: Where is the Gantt / timeline view? My manager showed me one in her account but I only see Board, List and Calendar.
how do i change the colour of a project? all mine are the same blue

subject: Workload view
body: How do I use the workload view to see who's overloaded next week? I opened it but everyone shows 0 hours even though they have tasks. Do I need to add time estimates to tasks first?

subject: Automations - where to start
body: Hi, I'd like to automatically assign new tasks in our "Support" project to whoever's on duty that week. Is that possible with automations? I've never set one up. Also, is there a way to see which automations already exist in our workspace? My predecessor may have set some up. Workspace ID ws_61033.
Is it possible to hide completed tasks from the board view? They pile up in the Done column.

subject: Private tasks
body: Can I create a task that only I can see, inside a shared project? I want to keep some personal reminders next to the team's work.

subject: Moving tasks between projects
body: How do I move a task from one project to another without losing its comments and attachments? When I tried copy-paste I lost the history.
what's the difference between archiving and deleting a project? i want to clean up but not lose anything forever

subject: Adding time estimates
body: How do I add a time estimate to a task, and can I see the total estimated time for a whole project somewhere? Our clients ask for effort estimates up front and I've been doing it in a spreadsheet.

subject: Getting started + pricing question
body: Two questions from a new user: how do I invite my team into a project I made (I see a share button but it asks for an email)? And second, is the free plan limited in the number of projects? I want to know before we build everything.

subject: Dashboard setup
body:
Hello,

I've been asked by our director to build a dashboard that shows, for each of our five regional teams, how many tasks are overdue, how many were completed this month, and the average time from creation to completion.

I've opened the dashboard builder, but I'm not sure which widget types to use, or how to split the numbers by team. Our teams are set up as separate projects, but some people work across two regions. Also, is it possible to share the dashboard with the director without giving her edit access to the projects themselves?

If there's a guide or a webinar for this, please point me to it. I'd rather learn it properly than keep guessing.

Thanks,
Tom Henshaw
Business Analyst

subject: Dark mode please
body: Please add a dark mode to the web app. I work late and the bright white UI is painful. Almost every other tool I use has it.
feature request: let us set a default assignee per project

subject: Request: Gantt baselines
body: It would be really useful to save a baseline in the Gantt view so we can compare the current schedule to the original plan. MS Project has this and it's the one thing our PMs miss since switching.

subject: Suggestion: bulk editing
body: Could you add bulk editing in the list view? Select 20 tasks and change their due date or assignee at once. Right now we do it one by one and it takes forever at the end of every sprint.

subject: Feature request - custom statuses per project
body:
Hi team,

We'd love the ability to define custom statuses per project rather than having one set for the whole workspace. Our design team uses "Brief - Concept - Review - Approved", our dev team uses "Backlog - In Progress - Code Review - QA - Done", and our finance team uses something else again. Right now we've had to create a giant list of statuses that covers everyone, so every team sees statuses that don't apply to them, and people pick the wrong ones all the time.

I know workspace-wide statuses make reporting easier. Maybe custom statuses could map to a small set of workspace-level categories (Not started / In progress / Done) so dashboards still work?

We're a 90-person company on the Business plan, and this comes up in almost every team meeting. Happy to jump on a call with your product team if it helps.

Thanks,
Meera Joshi
PMO Lead, Cartwright & Hale
Would love it if we could @mention a whole team (like @design) instead of each person individually.

subject: API webhooks for comments
body: Please add webhook events for comment.created and comment.updated. We've built an integration that needs to react to comments, and right now we have to poll every task, which burns through our rate limit.

subject: Idea: task templates inside projects
body: Could we have task templates, not just project templates? We create the same "new hire onboarding" task with 12 subtasks several times a month. Copying an old task works, but it brings along old comments and dates.
pls add an option to show week numbers in the calendar. we plan everything by week number here in sweden

subject: Request: better mobile offline
body: Our field staff need full offline support in the mobile app: create tasks, attach photos, fill in custom fields, and have it all sync when they're back online. Right now offline only lets you view. That's the main thing stopping us from rolling the app out to the rest of our 200 field workers.

subject: Feature request + small bug
body: Hi! Feature request: could you add a "snooze" option for tasks, so they disappear from my list until a chosen date? And a small bug I noticed: the "Today" filter includes tasks due tomorrow if you're east of UTC. Thanks for a great product!

subject: Two-way sync with Google Tasks
body: Any plans for a Google Tasks integration? Half our team keeps personal to-dos in Google Tasks and wants work tasks to show up there too.
Request: allow emoji in project names. Right now it strips them out. Our team uses emoji to tell projects apart at a glance.

subject: Time tracking improvements
body: Your time tracking is almost great. Three things would make it perfect: a timer that keeps running when I switch tasks (with a prompt), weekly timesheet approval by managers, and exporting timesheets to our payroll system. The last one especially. Right now I have to copy numbers by hand into Xero every Friday.

subject: Request for audit log on lower plans
body: We're on Pro and really need an audit log for compliance, but it's only on Enterprise, which is way out of our budget. Any chance of a basic audit log on Pro or Business? Even 30 days of history would help.
Can you please add a way to print a single task nicely? When we print from the browser, it prints the whole sidebar and cuts off the description.

subject: Feature suggestion: client portal branding
body: The client portal is great, but we'd love to use our own domain (projects.ouragency.com) instead of ourapp.com. Clients sometimes think the links are phishing. Any plans for custom domains?

subject: Mobile: widget + crash
body: Could you add a home screen widget for iOS showing today's tasks? And unrelated, the app crashes when I rotate my phone while a task is open. iPhone 14, latest version.
Missing emails for mentions and also the mobile app doesn't notify me either. So I'm missing everything unless I open the web app. Help?

subject: How-to + bug?
body: How do I set a task to repeat on the first Monday of every month? I tried "monthly" and it picks the same date each month instead. If that's not possible, then consider this a feature request. And separately, the repeat settings sometimes reset to "never" after I save, is that a bug?

subject: How to use guests
body: What's the best way to give a freelancer access to just one project? We don't want her to see the rest of the workspace. Is that a guest? Does it cost anything?
The Android app doesn't let me @mention anyone, the suggestion list never pops up. Works on web. Have to write comments on my laptop instead.

subject: Notification emails + digest
body: We never get the weekly digest emails and some people get individual notification emails but others don't, even with the same settings. It's inconsistent across our 20-person team. Can you check our workspace? acct_nt0f19

subject: How to create a template
body: How do I turn one of our projects into a template so we can reuse the structure for each new client? And will the template keep the assignees or will I need to set those each time?

Feature request: I'd like to be able to choose which day the weekly digest email arrives. Monday morning is the worst time for us, Friday afternoon would be better. Also, it'd be nice to choose which projects are included.

subject: Mobile app huge storage
body: The Android app is using 4.2 GB of storage on my phone. I don't have that many attachments. Is there a way to clear cached files without losing offline data? My phone keeps saying storage is full.

subject: Email notifications with wrong times
body: The times in notification emails are in UTC, not my time zone. For example, a task due at 5pm my time shows as due at 10pm in the email. In the app the times are correct.
Is there a way to color-code tasks by priority on the board? Like red for urgent. Couldn't find it in settings.

subject: Feature: recurring tasks with custom rules
body: Please support more flexible recurrence rules: every 2nd Tuesday, the last working day of the month, every weekday, etc. Our office runs on these schedules, and right now we're creating tasks manually or in a calendar outside the app.

subject: iOS app login loop
body: The iOS app keeps showing the login screen after I log in successfully. It goes: login, loading, back to login. I reinstalled twice. Web works. iOS 17.6, iPhone 13 mini.
Notification emails for task assignments stopped, but comment emails still arrive. Weird combo. Our settings didn't change.

subject: How do I use sections?
body: What's the difference between sections and columns? I'm in list view and I see sections, but when I switch to board view they turn into columns. Are they the same thing? I want to group tasks by phase.

subject: Request: read receipts on comments
body: It'd be useful to know who has read a comment, especially for announcements in a project. Some tools show "seen by". Would you consider adding that?
Can I get a notification when a task in a project I follow is completed? Right now I only get notified for my own tasks.

subject: Mobile app: attachments won't open
body: PDF attachments won't open in the Android app. It says "No app can open this file" even though I have Adobe Reader and Google Drive installed. Images open fine. The same PDFs open on the web. Our sales team uses the app to show contracts to clients on site.

subject: Feature request - SSO for Pro plan
body: We're a 12-person company and would love SSO, but we can't justify Enterprise pricing. Please consider offering basic Google SSO on Pro. It's a security requirement from one of our clients.
Where do I find the activity history for a task? Want to see who changed the due date.

subject: Emails from you land in quarantine
body: Our Microsoft 365 is quarantining your notification emails as "high confidence phish". Our admin released them, but new ones keep getting quarantined. Is there a list of your sending domains and IPs we can allowlist? Our org ID is 70881.

subject: Feature + how-to
body: Is there a way to make a field required when creating a task? E.g. every task in our "Requests" project must have a due date and a requester. If not, please consider it a feature request, because we get a lot of incomplete requests.
The mobile app's search only finds task titles, not text in descriptions or comments. Web search finds both. Is that intentional?

subject: Feature request: Kanban WIP limits
body: Please add work-in-progress limits to board columns (e.g. max 5 tasks in "In Progress"), with a visual warning when the limit is exceeded. It's standard Kanban practice and our team is trying to adopt it.

subject: How to share a board read-only
body: I want to share our product roadmap board with a few customers so they can see what's coming, but they shouldn't be able to edit anything or see the comments. What's the right way to do that?
The emails we send to clients through the client portal all show "via ourapp.com" in Gmail. Can we remove that? Looks unprofessional.

subject: Mobile - swipe actions
body: The swipe-to-complete action in the iOS app is super sensitive. I keep completing tasks accidentally when I'm just scrolling. Is there a way to turn off swipe actions?

subject: Email + mobile notifications
body: Our team gets both email and push notifications for everything, so every update is announced twice. How do we set it so push notifications come first and email only goes out if you haven't seen the push within an hour? Is that possible?
